# Neuroscience Journal Club

> A research community hub at Rockefeller University for neuroscience seminars, journal club discussions, and behavioral neuroscience education.

The Neuroscience Journal Club at Rockefeller University hosts weekly meetings where researchers discuss landmark papers and current neuroscience research. The site also archives behavioral neuroscience courses and specialized seminars led by faculty including Leslie Vosshall, Jim Hudspeth, and other leading neuroscientists.

## Key Topics

- Rockefeller University
- Neuroscience Journal Club

## Journal Club Overview

- [Neuroscience Journal Club Homepage](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/): Root homepage for Neuroscience Journal Club at Rockefeller University
- [About the Journal Club](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/about.php): About page describing the Neuroscience Journal Club's mission and weekly meetings
- [Contact & Membership](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/contact.php): Contact information and mailing list for Neuroscience Journal Club membership

## Behavioral Neuroscience Courses

- [Behavioral Neuroscience Course 2006](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/BN2006.php): 2006 Behavioral Neuroscience Course schedule with lectures on brain-behavior
- [Behavioral Neuroscience Course 2008](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/BN2008.php): 2008 Behavioral Neuroscience Course lecture series and student presentations
- [Behavioral Neuroscience Course 2010](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/BN2010.php): 2010 Behavioral Neuroscience Course covering genetics and brain-behavior topics

## Specialized Seminars

- [Experiment and Theory in Modern Biology Course 2008](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/ETMB2008.php): 2008 graduate seminar on landmark papers in molecular biology and genetics

- [Journal Club 2001 Archive](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/njc2001.php): 2001 archive of Neuroscience Journal Club meetings and paper discussions

- [Journal Club 2003 Archive](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/njc2003.php): 2003 archive of Neuroscience Journal Club research seminars and discussions
- [Journal Club 2004 Archive](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/njc2004.php): 2004 archive of Neuroscience Journal Club seminar schedule and presentations
- [Journal Club 2005 Archive](https://njc.rockefeller.edu/njc2005.php): 2005 archive of Neuroscience Journal Club literature reviews and discussions
